preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A <= 1000000 and 0 <= B <= 1000000 and 0 <= C <= 1000000 for A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A, B, and C are between 0 and 1000000.

preconditions.expression: all(A + B + C >= 1 for A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sum of A, B, and C is at least 1.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((A + 2*B + 3*C) % 2 == 0 for A, B, C in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The sum of elements in S is even for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((A + B + C) % 2 == 0 for A, B, C in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The total number of elements in S is even for each test case.
